howToAdd: Append an object to tools and add a folder at that href with an index.html. Fields: name, description, href, icon (pen, press, bind, or dot), kicker, chapter, line. Optional counter is the usage key; if omitted it is the folder name. Call ToolsUsage.recordUse(counter) when a download finishes.

tools.name: Forms Filler
tools.description: Read your papers on this device and prefill a form, then sign it in the editor.
tools.line: A blank form and the papers that answer it. You sign the result in the editor.

tools.name: Edit and Sign PDF
tools.description: Write, cover, highlight, and sign. The file never leaves this browser.
tools.line: Text, white-out, and a signature drawn with a mouse, a finger, or a pen.

tools.name: Reduce PDF file size
tools.description: Shrink a PDF and read the real size of each version before you keep it.
tools.line: Photographs get smaller. Sentences stay sharp, selectable type.

tools.name: Convert images to one PDF
tools.description: A folder of pictures, in order, bound into one document on your machine.
tools.line: Portrait or landscape, one page each, turned when that fits the sheet better.

tools.name: Merge and split PDF
tools.description: Stack several PDFs, reorder every page, or pull a range back out.
tools.line: Drag pages across files, then keep them as one document or several.

tools.name: Shrink and resize photos
tools.description: Fit pictures under a file size, a percent, or exact pixels.
tools.line: A target weight, a percentage, or a width and a height. JPEG, WebP, or PNG.
